subject: Restore UWORD distance ties in swordfight rebalancing
description: DONE. In schema14 Savegame_linux3/Profile_003/Restart/replay-004, Soldier 84's frame-866 ReconsiderSwordfight reached the imbalanced relationship branch with the same relationship sets and iteration order as Original, but Rust selected Soldier 84 itself as PC 171's nearest opponent and returned through direct rebalancing before the four expected alcohol/CombatReposition/ProposeGoodSwordStrike draws. Original RHArtificialMalignity::CalculateOpponentOfMauriceWhoIsNearestToRene stores `(UWORD)(posRene - Position(opponent)).MaxNorm()` before its strict less-than comparison; RHposition contains the raw map X/Y copied by RHPositionInterface::GetPosition. Soldier 80 and Soldier 84 have fractionally different raw map-space MaxNorm distances that truncate to the same UWORD, so Original retains first-listed Soldier 80 while Rust's f32 comparison incorrectly selected the later Soldier 84. Rust now truncates before comparing, with a focused fractional-tie regression. The exact replay clears frame 866 and advances to an independent Soldier 80 position-goal mismatch at frame 920. Task #67's corrected Stop ordering also proved task #64's synchronous reciprocal-Enter promotion unnecessary and source-wrong: non-WAIT LaunchSequenceElement appends to the manager FIFO. The promotion was removed and its test corrected to use a valid melee range, require successful entry, and assert the reciprocal remains queued. The #64 control clears its old frame-1601 RNG frontier and advances to the independent frame-1837 PC motion mismatch. Task #36's Cyrdach and Nescafe replay-009 controls both still match every recorded frame.
